# Xingyun Web Agent SDK

Official self-contained Web `XingyunAvatarAgent` SDK, including its XmovAvatar renderer.
Retrieved 2026-10-23 from https://media.xingyun3d.com/xingyun3d/general/litesdk/xmovAvatar_e2e@latest.js
and pinned locally as `xingyunAvatarAgent.8d03fe57.js`. The bundled renderer identifies as 2.4.1.
SHA-256: `8d03fe57a3a2ed6e0614029471c8e4b91705f9385b67ae1b93da49dfa7e5d612`.

Documentation: https://www.xingyun3d.com/developers/67-541
Brain providers: https://www.xingyun3d.com/developers/72-573
The current gateway was verified with provider `openai` and the app's server-side compatible API.
The Web SDK's `session_speak_req_id: 1` and v2 frame protocol must survive the signing proxy.
No provider API key or Xingyun app secret is included in these assets.
Vendor copyright and embedded notices remain in the original bundle. The SDK is subject to Xingyun's terms.
